candidates.statement: Payment service shows elevated latency (p95 1950ms) and an ERROR payment.authorize span at 1650ms, with 11 downstream_deadline_exceeded 504 warnings. Order calls payment per topology, so checkout degradation is bounded to payment downstream latency.
candidates.uncertainty: Which downstream dependency of payment is slow is not observed; payment's own downstream targets are absent from topology.

report.explanation: Payment is the only service with elevated p95 (1950ms), an ERROR authorize span, and 504 deadline-exceeded logs, while gateway, order, and inventory remain healthy. Gateway deploy record alone does not establish latency causation. Root cause is bounded to payment downstream latency; the specific slow dependency is unobserved.
